products.name: Viper V3 Pro Wireless
products.description: Razer's flagship wireless mouse for esports, built on the HyperPolling wireless dongle for near-zero latency. Ultra-lightweight shell, Optical Switches Gen-3 and an 8000Hz-ready sensor make it one of the most responsive mice available.

products.name: G PRO X Superlight 2
products.description: The Superlight 2 refines Logitech's championship-grade mouse with a lighter shell, the HERO 2 sensor and LIGHTSPEED wireless. Built for players who need pinpoint tracking without any added weight.

products.name: Pulsar X2V2
products.description: A symmetrical, hollow-shell wireless mouse designed with the competitive FPS community. The X2V2 pairs a lag-free 4K wireless connection with a feather-light frame for fast flicks and long sessions.

products.name: ATK F1 Ultimate
products.description: ATK's F1 Ultimate brings a magnesium-alloy shell down to an ultra-light weight while keeping a stiff, rattle-free build. A great pick for players who want a premium feel without the flagship price tag.

products.name: Huntsman V3 Pro
products.description: Razer's fastest analog optical keyboard, with adjustable actuation points on every key. The aluminum top plate and dedicated multi-function dial make it a serious tool for both gaming and everyday typing.

products.name: Apex Pro TKL Wireless
products.description: SteelSeries' TKL wireless keyboard combines OmniPoint 2.0 adjustable switches with a dual-wireless setup (2.4GHz + Bluetooth). Compact footprint, aircraft-grade aluminum frame and a battery that lasts for days.

products.name: G PRO X TKL
products.description: A tenkeyless version of Logitech's tournament keyboard, built with GX mechanical switches and a detachable cable. Light, compact and tuned for competitive play without sacrificing durability.

products.name: Alloy Origins 65
products.description: HyperX's compact 65% mechanical keyboard pairs hot-swappable switches with a solid steel plate. Small enough to free up desk space, tough enough for daily gaming.

products.name: BlackShark V2 Pro
products.description: Razer's flagship gaming headset uses Nexus Audio drivers with TriForce titanium technology for detailed, accurate sound, plus an AI-enhanced mic for clear comms.

products.name: Cloud III Wireless
products.description: HyperX Cloud III Wireless keeps the comfort the Cloud series is known for and adds up to 120 hours of battery life with DTS spatial audio support.

products.name: Arctis Nova 7
products.description: SteelSeries Arctis Nova 7 delivers multi-platform wireless connectivity (2.4GHz + Bluetooth simultaneously) with a ClearCast Gen 2 microphone and all-day comfort.

products.name: GameSir G7 SE
products.description: A compact wireless controller with Hall-effect joysticks that resist drift, remappable back buttons and a fast 2.4GHz connection — built for both console and PC play.

products.name: GameSir T4 Kaleid
products.description: GameSir's T4 Kaleid mixes a translucent kaleidoscope shell with reliable hybrid switches and multi-platform compatibility (PC, Switch, Android, iOS).

products.name: HyperX QuadCast 2
products.description: HyperX's dual-capsule USB microphone with 4 polar patterns, a smart gain control and a new tap-to-mute sensor with LED indicator — plug-and-play streaming audio.

products.name: HAVIT Gaming Microphone
products.description: An affordable condenser USB microphone with a cardioid pickup pattern and a compact tripod stand, ideal for streamers and casual gamers starting out.

products.name: UGREEN USB-C Hub
products.description: A 6-in-1 USB-C hub adding HDMI, USB-A and card-reader ports to any laptop or tablet, with compact aluminum housing built for travel.
